Team —

Putting together the final cadence for the upcoming level-change reviews. This thread is confidential — please do not forward outside the recipients. Two asks to start: (1) confirm committee availability windows (attached draft .ics); (2) surface any redlines to the packet language by EOD Tuesday so HR can consolidate before the committee packet goes live.

Candidates covered: Anya Khan (IC4 -> IC5), Daniel Ortega (L6 -> L7), and Priya N. (L4 -> L5 scope adjust). I attached the latest writeup for Anya and a first-pass redline summary from Vivek.

Proposed committee windows (PST):
- Thurs 7/8, 9:30–11:00
- Fri 7/9, 13:00–14:30
- Mon 7/12, 10:00–11:30

Please reply with: CONFIRM for any of the above, or ALT + your preferred times. Also note any blocking items (comp requests, comp band exceptions, or escalation required).

Thanks —
